buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.visual: low settler hall growing into a fieldstone-and-timber meeting house with a restrained bell frame; administrative, practical, no heraldry

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.visual: narrow timber lookout on a stone-footed base, readable ladder and platform, no oversized fantasy spire

buildings.name: Storehouse
buildings.visual: raised storage house on stone stilts, sealed timber walls, practical loading step, protected from flood and rats

buildings.name: The Scrivener's Tent
buildings.visual: patched record-keeper awning with desk, stools, ledger chest and hanging lantern; civilian rather than military

buildings.name: Fisher's Hut
buildings.visual: compact weathered fisher shelter with racks, baskets and coiled nets attached to the structure; no water or dock terrain

buildings.name: The Sawpit
buildings.visual: beam-framed work rig with a log and long pit saw, restrained timber stacks; represent the pit only through structure, never a ground hole

buildings.name: The Adit
buildings.visual: heavy timber mine portal with doors, baskets and an ore sled attached; no cliff, rubble field or terrain chunk

buildings.name: The Seed Garden
buildings.visual: four raised planting beds enclosed by low wattle fencing, seed sacks and rain barrel; beds are constructed objects, no surrounding soil patch

buildings.name: The Fence's Tent
buildings.visual: low patched trading tent with lockbox and concealed shelves, discreet and weathered, no carnival styling

buildings.name: The Workyard
buildings.visual: open timber workshop combining benches, hoist and tool racks beneath partial roofs, visually busy but one coherent structure

buildings.name: The Smelter
buildings.visual: masonry furnace with short chimney, bellows and attached work canopy, honest ember light only, no smoke cloud or ground scorch

buildings.name: The Smokehouse
buildings.visual: tight timber smokehouse with vented roof, hanging hooks under a small side awning and stacked fuel, no detached food spread

buildings.name: The Trophy Wall
buildings.visual: freestanding fortified timber wall displaying restrained hunt trophies and iron hooks, not a full hall and not a gore shrine

buildings.name: Shrine of the Silent
buildings.visual: empty aniconic roadside shrine of dark stone and timber with no statue or face, one modest offering ledge

buildings.name: The Trading Post
buildings.visual: sturdy covered counter and store room with tied crates, scales and a restrained hanging sign, practical frontier commerce
